metadata.title: ProjectX UI
metadata.description: A fully custom React component library based on the ProjectX UI design. No shadcn, no Radix, no external UI dependencies.

home.titleLine2: built on the ProjectX UI design.
home.intro: Works like shadcn — same composition, same copy-paste approach — but without a single line of code from shadcn, Radix or any other UI library. Everything lives in your own repo.
home.allDescription: From button to command palette, from table to donut chart.

zeroDeps.title: Zero UI dependencies
zeroDeps.text: No shadcn, no Radix, no Headless UI. Every component — focus trap, positioning and keyboard navigation included — is written right here.

tokens.title: Every color from one source
tokens.text: Every color, radius and shadow comes from the ProjectX UI design. Components use tokens only, never a hardcoded hex.

copyPaste.title: Copy-paste, your code
copyPaste.text: Just like shadcn: `npx projectx-ui add button` copies the source into your project. You own the components and change them whenever you like.

theme.title: Light and dark
theme.text: One ThemeProvider, two complete palettes. Everything follows along, charts and overlays included.
